audience: people who land on the AI Essentials Academy page (Arabic-speaking staff and trainers; the film uses the page's English version)
promise: the real landing page of the academy, flown over in one continuous 3D camera move, ending on the page's own line
cta: none on screen beyond the page's own buttons; the end card carries the brand badge and the closing line
direction: Owner brief (2026-10-15): 3D fly-over of the landing page on a bright studio floor; one camera, never a cut; razor-thin focus; pieces lift and stand up; four logo tiles; end card in Geist 500 + Instrument Serif italic.

assets.rights: The owner's own landing page (coolman1984/Course AI_Academy.html), captured in this session
Geist (SIL OFL 1.1, assets/fonts/OFL-geist.txt) and Instrument Serif (SIL OFL 1.1, already vendored)

sound.note: Original score synthesised in film24/score.mjs; hit on 9.97 s, whooshes on 8.66 and 9.80 s; no samples

creative.problem: a landing page is usually seen as a flat scroll
creative.promise: the page as a physical object you fly over
creative.evidence: the real page, captured at 1440 px, every piece its own layer
creative.motif: logo tiles that lift off beside the hero button and return on the end card
creative.light: bright studio floor, soft wide shadows
creative.camera: one camera: steady backward glide at 56°, rise to overhead, dive into the hero
creative.motion: one speed curve integrated into page position; pieces stand up about their own middle
creative.sound: steady groove under the glide, build under the rise, hit on the dive
creative.pacing: steady flight, even rise, quick dive, long breathing hold
creative.payoff: the hero lands as a card under the two-line title

shots.purpose: glide backwards down the landing page at one steady speed, sections sharp as they cross the middle

craft.scale: the page on a studio floor, pieces lifting and standing up
craft.camera: one continuous camera, 56° tilt, distance easing out 1360→1700, never turning

shots.purpose: zoom out at an even rate while the tilt flattens; the page's bottom edge settles 42 px above the frame bottom
the whole page as one centred strip
dive into the hero; it lands as a 1018 px card

craft.camera: log scale quad in-out, top edge pinned

shots.purpose: badge, statement and italic tail over the hero card
